title: Python maintenance candidate output accepted a caller-selected filesystem path
title_de: Kandidatenausgabe der Python-Wartung akzeptierte einen vom Aufrufer gewählten Dateisystempfad
profile: Framework CPython 3.13 updater Draft PR exact-head SonarCloud remediation
technical_claim: SonarCloud PR #39 reports pythonsecurity:S8707 at the os.open sink in write_candidate_file. Before remediation, --write-candidate-file accepted a command-line Path and propagated it through runner_temp_child to os.open. The helper performed a containment check, but the security boundary still permitted caller-selected path construction and the hosted taint rule correctly rejects that design for a filesystem-writing CLI.
entry_point: The scheduled/manual candidate-validation workflow invokes ci/tools/update-python-version.py with --write-candidate-file.
source_to_sink_or_broken_control: A supplied argument becomes args.write_candidate_file, then write_candidate_file(..., path), then target passed to os.open(..., O_CREAT | O_EXCL).
attacker_prerequisites: Control of the updater command-line candidate-output argument in an execution context.
The updater reaches an available, validated candidate path.
observed_behavior: SonarCloud quality-gate analysis for the exact Draft PR head created open vulnerability AZ-BJmyc1Sm1F-_jUkdR at ci/tools/update-python-version.py line 390 and rated Security on New Code C.
expected_behavior: The candidate artifact path is not caller-selectable: it is always the fixed direct child $RUNNER_TEMP/framework-python-3.13-candidate, and an absent/symlink output fails closed.
impact: A path-writing boundary relies on validation of a user-supplied path rather than deriving the only allowed filename at the enforcement point. SonarCloud classifies the new-code result as a high security impact; this record treats it as release-blocking until the narrow fixed-path design and current-head analysis pass.
preconditions: The updater is invoked with the candidate-file flag.
RUNNER_TEMP exists as the runner-owned output root.
reproduction: Run SonarCloud analysis for PR #39 exact head 4a31df044ea2c2c7526828e54978238639b57dd4.
Observe S8707 source-to-sink flow from CLI parser through write_candidate_file to os.open.

evidence.command: RTK-wrapped SonarCloud quality-gate and issue API queries for PR 39
evidence.summary: Quality Gate failed solely on new_security_rating=3. Issue AZ-BJmyc1Sm1F-_jUkdR is open at update-python-version.py:390 with rule pythonsecurity:S8707.

evidence.command: RTK-wrapped complete remediation validation and security-diff scan after the updater derives its fixed candidate path internally and rejects an extra CLI destination
evidence.summary: The updater exposes a no-value candidate-file flag, derives only RUNNER_TEMP/framework-python-3.13-candidate, preserves exclusive/symlink-safe creation, and passes its focused plus complete local validation.

root_cause: The candidate-file CLI option exposed a Path value even though the workflow and contract require exactly one runner-temporary filename. The validation helper did not eliminate the caller-selected path boundary.
proposed_remediation: Make --write-candidate-file a no-value flag and derive the sole candidate filename from the validated RUNNER_TEMP directory inside the updater. Preserve O_EXCL creation, regular/symlink rejection, the exact workflow setup-python reference, and the no-update/no-write behavior. Add a regression proving an extra destination argument is rejected and retain successful fixed-file materialization.
acceptance_criteria: The updater exposes no candidate-output Path parameter.
A fixed known candidate path is derived only from RUNNER_TEMP and remains a direct child.
A caller-supplied extra destination is rejected by argument parsing.
The legitimate candidate workflow and semantic contracts still use the exact fixed artifact.
Focused tests, local security checks, and a fresh exact-head SonarCloud analysis pass.
validation_plan: Add and run the focused pre-fix parser regression and fixed-file behavior test.
Run updater and workflow-contract tests, workflow lint, full Framework lint, and a focused security re-review.
Push the remediated head and verify SonarCloud's PR condition and issue status at that exact SHA.
legitimate_control_tests: A validated candidate writes exactly $RUNNER_TEMP/framework-python-3.13-candidate with the expected version text.
The candidate setup action still reads the same exact runner-temporary file.
bypass_review: Recheck relative, absolute, traversal, symlink, pre-existing, and extra-command-line destination forms; verify the only retained output path is derived from RUNNER_TEMP and that no other filesystem sink consumes a caller-selected candidate path.
deduplication_note: No existing local finding owns the new updater candidate-file CLI-to-filesystem sink reported by hosted SonarCloud. It is distinct from FND-FRAMEWORK-0033's workflow secret-expression contract.
evidence_limitations: The hosted finding is static taint evidence; no unsafe filesystem write is intentionally performed.
The original candidate workflow is schedule/manual only, but that trusted trigger does not justify a caller-selectable write target.
residual_risk: The fixed-path remediation has complete local validation, but until the remediated commit is pushed and its exact-head SonarCloud analysis closes S8707 and passes the PR Quality Gate, the Draft PR remains a release blocker and may not reach verified_pr.

history.detail: PR #39 exact-head SonarCloud analysis reported S8707 and Security on New Code C; remediation was started before any verified_pr claim.

The CLI no longer accepts a candidate destination. The updater derives its only runner-temporary direct child internally, rejects an extra argument, preserves exclusive/symlink-safe creation, and passed focused tests, native gates, and the sealed follow-up scan. The current-head SonarCloud reanalysis remains required.
